Killam Fellowships Program (Fulbright Canada)
records.official_source: Fulbright Canada, Foundation for Educational Exchange between Canada and the United States of America
records.deadline_display: January 31 for the open competition; institution-set internal deadline for the direct exchange
records.application_period: The competition opens annually on August 15. Applications are for placement in Fall or Spring of the next school year, submitted by the internal deadline of the home institution for the direct exchange route, or by January 31 for the open competition.
